daily_take.headline: xQc's GTA VI Speedrun Just Got Real. Market Overreacting to Dust.
daily_take.deck: The odds on xQc finishing GTA VI by November 22 collapsed 15.7 points overnight to 75.6%. Classic panic move on a streamer market with thin conviction. Here's the reality: xQc has 47 days to finish a game that takes 30-40 hours for a motivated player. He streams 8-10 hours daily. The market's spooked by nothing concrete. Smart play is backing YES at 75% and watching for the capitulation fade.
